environment: Linux isolated COPY of original persisted DATA; no production data writes, no native MT5, no orders

warnings: 75 internal gap(s), 45014 missing bar(s) — listed for inspection; week-end/session closures are normal stored data
initial_range_count.range_coverage_policy: Observed unique valid UTC records in [start,end); boundaries/gaps >96h flagged; market calendar not independently verified

period.label: CUSTOM
period.convention: Calendar-based windows measured backwards from the period end (UTC): 1 DAY..14 DAYS are 24-hour periods; 1/3/6 MONTHS and 1/2/3 YEARS are calendar months/years (day clamped to the month's length). The window selects HISTORY RANGE ONLY — the node's configured candle timeframe is never changed.

conventions.net_pnl: gross P&L minus modelled spread, slippage and commission costs
conventions.max_drawdown_pct: peak-to-trough of the realised closed-trade equity curve over initial capital
conventions.sharpe: mean/std of per-trade returns on initial capital, annualised x sqrt(252); N/A below 2 trades
conventions.profit_factor: gross profit / gross loss; N/A when there are no losing trades
conventions.sessions: labelled by the stored bar timestamps (UTC clock hour bands); scenario session filters are recorded in the scenario settings
conventions.no_nan_policy: every undefined metric is null with a reason in `unavailable`

engine_versions.mt5_historical_adapter: MT5->pandas historical adapter v1 (no broker orders)
